+from datetime import date
+from shipping.delivery import estimate_delivery, is_business_day

events.text:
Root cause confirmed: `shipping/delivery.py:22` `add_business_days` uses `weekday() < 6`, counting Saturday as a business day (vs `is_business_day:15` correctly using `< 5`). So Friday express +1 lands Saturday 2026-10-24, where carrier `book()` raises `ValueError: no delivery slots` (orders 5512/5530).

CI green because `tests/test_delivery.py` only covers Mon/Tue starts, never Friday-over-weekend. Regression `test_express_from_friday_skips_weekend` fails on current code (got 2026-10-24, expected Monday 2026-10-26), proving it.
